_read_me: The Contact page's form (contact.html). One setting decides which wording it shows: mode.
mode "quote": "Request a quote", with two optional tick boxes for texts and offers. Needed while the new number goes through texting approval (A2P); Imperion asked for it, November 12, 2026.
mode "question": the form as it was before, "Got a question first?". Switch back to this once texting is approved: change the one word and redeploy.
Both wordings stay in this file. HTML is allowed in the text (links, ’). {phone} becomes the business number (config/business.json, or BUSINESS_PHONE in Netlify).
A mistake in this file fails the build.

question.heading: Got a question first?
question.intro: Not ready to book, or not sure which package fits? Ask us anything about your vehicle’s condition, what’s realistic to fix, pricing, or timing. A real person answers, usually same day.
question.cardSub: Tell us what you’re dealing with and we’ll point you the right way.
question.subject: QUESTION from 513autoclean.com
question.fineprint: No spam, ever. We only use your info to answer your question. See our Privacy Policy.

quote.heading: Request a quote
quote.intro: Tell us about your vehicle and what you need, and we will send you a quote. A real person answers, usually same day.
quote.cardSub: Tell us what you’re dealing with and we’ll point you the right way.
quote.subject: QUOTE REQUEST from 513autoclean.com
quote.fineprint: No spam, ever. We only use your info to send your quote.
quote.success: Thanks, your quote request is in. I'll get back to you shortly, usually the same day.
